data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2031 in Marbella is a spectacle you won't forget—and there's no better seat than on the water. A Marbella boat rental New Year's Eve fireworks charter gives you front-row views of the Puerto Banús display, away from the crowded promenades. With a private skipper, chilled cava, and the glittering Costa del Sol skyline as your backdrop, you can toast 2032 in style. Our fleet includes everything from intimate speedboats for five to superyachts for twelve, all departing from Puerto Banús. Prices start at €749 for a two-hour trip, inclusive of drinks, snacks, and VAT. Below, we break down the best boats, the viewing logistics, and how to secure your spot before they sell out.

Why Choose a Boat for NYE Fireworks?

Marbella's New Year's Eve fireworks are launched from the pier at Puerto Banús, and the bay offers a perfect natural amphitheatre. From a boat, you get an unobstructed, 180-degree view without the crush of thousands on the Golden Mile. The sound echoes off the water, and the reflections on the sea double the visual impact. Plus, you control the music, the drinks, and the company. It's a private party that moves with you. For groups of 5–12, the cost per person is often less than a dinner at a beach club, and you get a skipper, fuel, insurance, and a fully stocked bar included.

Our Fleet for NYE 2031

We have 16 boats based in Puerto Banús, all available for NYE charters. Here are the most popular options:

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

How the Evening Unfolds

Your charter typically starts between 18:00 and 20:00, depending on the package. You'll meet your skipper at the designated pontoon in Puerto Banús. After a safety briefing, you motor out toward the bay. As dusk falls, you'll see the lights of Marbella, La Concha mountain, and the distant glow of Estepona. The skipper anchors in a prime spot near the harbour entrance. At midnight, the fireworks begin—typically a 12- to 15-minute display choreographed to music. After the finale, you cruise back to port, often with the party continuing on board. Return is by 02:00.

Which Boat Should You Book?

For a romantic evening, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are ideal—both start at €749 for two hours. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, €4,719 for four hours) includes a jet ski for daytime fun. If you want absolute luxury, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge, salon, and full crew—but book early, as only one is available. Budget-conscious groups can opt for the Speedboat (6 pax) or Dubhe (5 pax), both priced on request. Bear in mind that the smaller boats have less shelter, so bring a jacket—December sea temperatures average 16°C.

What's Included and What's Not

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. Not included: premium spirits, champagne (you can bring your own), food beyond snacks, and dockage fees if you request a stop at a beach club (rare on NYE). Tipping the skipper is customary but not mandatory. If you want a full dinner, we can arrange catering for larger yachts at an extra cost—contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

How to Book and Secure Your Spot

NYE is our busiest night of the year. Boats start getting booked from October, and by mid-December most prime slots are gone. To reserve, send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred boat, number of guests, and desired duration. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link. A 50% deposit secures the booking; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Cancellations made 14+ days out receive a full refund; within 7 days, no refund unless we can rebook. For last-minute bookings (within 48 hours), full payment is required.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a NYE charter last?

Most NYE charters are 4–8 hours, starting late afternoon to catch sunset and the fireworks. The 2-hour option (€749) is available for a quick fireworks-only trip, but we recommend 4+ hours for the full experience.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring extra food or premium drinks. Our standard charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There is no corkage fee.

What happens if the weather is bad?

Your safety is paramount. If the forecast shows dangerous conditions (high winds, rough seas) 24 hours before, we will offer a full refund or reschedule to another date. The skipper makes the final call on the day.

How many people can I bring?

Capacity varies by boat: small speedboats (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) take up to 5 pax; Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 take 9–11 pax; larger yachts like Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 take up to 12 pax. Children count as passengers.

Where do we meet the boat?

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. We will send you the exact pontoon and berth number a day before. Parking is available nearby (paid). Arrive 15 minutes early.

Is the fireworks view guaranteed?

We anchor in the bay with an unobstructed view of the Puerto Banús fireworks. No buildings, no crowds. The skipper positions the boat for the best angle. In rare cases of last-minute cancellation by the town hall, we will refund or reschedule.

Can we stay overnight on the boat?

No, NYE charters are for the evening only. All boats return to port by 02:00. Overnight stays are not permitted for insurance reasons.

Do you offer a DJ or sound system?

Most of our larger yachts (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94) have built-in sound systems. You can connect your phone via Bluetooth. For small boats, we can arrange a portable speaker on request.
